acquisition method: a seven-day time course shotgun proteomics study was performed on Vero E6 cells
labeling: comparative quantitative proteomic analysis from oro- and naso-pharyngeal swabs used for COVID-19 diagnosis was performed
precursor tolerance: The peptides were validated using PepQuery analysis with MS tolerance of 10 ppm and MS/MS tolerance of 0.05 Da.
fragment tolerance: The peptides were validated using PepQuery analysis with MS tolerance of 10 ppm and MS/MS tolerance of 0.05 Da.
ptm: Unrestricted modification searching and amino acid substitutions were enabled in PepQuery to ensure the most rigorous search possible
